mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID, OWNER_ID, STATUS FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT TRANSFER_ID, GROUP_ID, FROM_MEMBER_ID, TO_MEMBER_ID, ACCEPTED_YN, STATUS FROM LEADER_TRANSFER_REQUEST WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY TRANSFER_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONSENT C JOIN GYE_MEMBER GM ON GM.GROUP_ID = C.GROUP_ID AND GM.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE C.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND C.TARGET_ID = #{transferId} AND C.CONSENT_TYPE = 'TRANSFER' AND C.AGREED_YN = 'Y'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONSENT C JOIN GYE_MEMBER GM ON GM.GROUP_ID = C.GROUP_ID AND GM.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE C.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND C.TARGET_ID = #{transferId} AND C.CONSENT_TYPE = 'TRANSFER' AND C.AGREED_YN = 'N'
SELECT GM.MEMBER_ID, M.NAME FROM GYE_MEMBER GM JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = GM.MEMBER_ID WHERE GM.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND GM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND GM.MEMBER_ID != #{ownerId} ORDER BY GM.MEMBER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LEADER_TRANSFER_REQUEST ( TRANSFER_ID, GROUP_ID, FROM_MEMBER_ID, TO_MEMBER_ID, ACCEPTED_YN, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{transferId}, #{groupId}, #{fromId}, #{toId}, 'N', 'PENDING', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE LEADER_TRANSFER_REQUEST SET ACCEPTED_YN = 'Y', ACCEPTED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TRANSFER_ID = #{transferId} AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND ACCEPTED_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONSENT ( CONSENT_ID, CONSENT_TYPE, TARGET_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, AGREED_YN, AGREED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONSENT.NEXTVAL, 'TRANSFER', #{transferId}, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{agreedYn}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE GYE_ACCOUNT SET VERIFY_STATUS = 'REVERIFY_REQUIRED', VERIFIED_BY = NULL, VERIFIED_AT = NULL WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'CURRENT'
UPDATE LEADER_TRANSFER_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'CONFIRMED', DECIDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TRANSFER_ID = #{transferId} AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND ACCEPTED_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_LOG_ID, GROUP_ID, ACTOR_MEMBER_ID, TARGET_MEMBER_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{actorId}, #{targetId}, #{eventType}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
